notes: This is the Rental Housing Act of 1985 - rent stabilisation, grounds for eviction, retaliation, late fees and relocation assistance - and it is the heart of everyday District tenancy law. The consumer half of this topic is a separate statute: Title 28, Chapter 39 - Consumer Protection Procedures (ss 28-3901 to 28-3913, the CPPA), verified in the same session at https://code.dccouncil.gov/us/dc/council/code/titles/28/chapters/39, where s 28-3904 is 'Unfair or deceptive trade practices' and s 28-3911 is marked '[Repealed]'. Encode the CPPA separately if the corpus wants consumer protection as its own subject.
